intro: Transform how you store with the Slide N Store XL. Its expanded interiors, secret compartment, and contemporary design make it the perfect addition for a stylish, clutter-free home.

features.title: Steel that lasts a lifetime
features.text: Built with high-quality CRCA steel, this wardrobe ensures lasting durability and resistance to daily wear and tear. Now, peace of mind is a one-time investment!

features.title: Space-saving sliding door mechanism
features.text: Equipped with 2 sliding doors, it optimises space utilisation, giving you easy and smooth access to your stored items, even in tight spaces.

features.title: Spacious storage for effortless organisation
features.text: Designed with mulitple shelves and drawers, it offers ample room to store everything you need, from clothing and accessories to seasonal items.

features.title: Secret lockers for extra security
features.text: Each drawer features a secret locker to keep your valuables and important items safe and discreetly stored, providing added security and privacy.

features.title: Reflect your world effortlessly
features.text: The built-in mirror adds both style and convenience, making it easier to check your outfit while saving space and adding elegance to your almirah.

name: Slide N Store Xl 2-Door Steel Wardrobe With Mirror Matte Sky Gray
